name: dogfood-nuxt-webtransport-stream-app
description: Dogfood app v1.28-3 — a Nuxt 3 + aioquic HTTP/3 + WebTransport uni/bi + Datagram + 0-RTT resumption + connection migration stream room that exercises the WebTransport axes across a provider-neutral WebTransportStreamAdapter, drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (calls aioquic + Chrome experimental flag when WEBTRANSPORT_KEY=1) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa-lab/realtime v0.2 createWebTransportUniMock + createWebTransportBiMock) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 12-axis release gate.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/realtime @kiwa-lab/core @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --hookTimeout 30000
